title: Zero Result Rescue
summary: Turns an empty search into fixes that are proven to return results: a spelling fix, a layout fix, a dropped filter or all categories.
description: Empty-search helper that explains what got in the way and offers only fixes that return results: did-you-mean from your vocabulary, the query retyped in the right layout or without Caps Lock, dropping the filter that hides everything, or all categories, each with a count.
catches: Wrong keyboard layout and Caps Lock
The single filter that hides every result
A category scope that's too narrow
Only fixes with a non-zero count are shown
limits: Counts come from your count function; slow APIs delay suggestions
Did-you-mean is limited to the vocabulary you pass
a11y: Region is role=status with aria-busy while counting
Fix buttons include their reason and count as text
stops: Users quit on empty search results
